Posted 'TDIGWATT' dested This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (the strategy plays Lando from the prison and Sabacc); 'CC Prison' Cloud City: Security Tower; 'CC Sabac' Cloud City Sabacc; 'Trooper Sabac' Trooper Sabacc; 'Zuckus' the Zuckuss character; 'Boba Feet In Slave 1' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Crush The Rebel' Crush The Rebellion; 'Secret Plan' Secret Plans; 'Lando' the Dark Cloud City Lando Calrissian.
'Grapler x2' is UNKNOWN: no 'Grappler'/'Grabber' card existed in February 2000 (Allegations Of Corruption is a 2001 Coruscant card), shown as posted.
The strategy says 'Start With Any Method Necessary to get the prison, Zuckus, And His Starhip', so Any Methods Necessary is the starting Interrupt.

Secret Plans and Resistance are the older Effects (no Defensive Shields existed in February 2000). The strategy says Dominic and Yannick Lapointe built the deck together since January; it is credited to the poster.
